hypothesis: Okapi BM25 should close the large gap between PostgreSQL ts_rank FTS and dense retrieval; BM25+dense RRF may improve coverage
rationale: Current FTS yielded very low recall on natural-language questions. BM25 is a standard lexical baseline, so this isolates whether score function/tokenization or lexical-vs-semantic matching explains that gap.

configuration.bm25: Okapi BM25 (k1=1.5, b=0.75; local implementation over corpus.jsonl)
